full_judgment:
Mr. Shahidul Islam J.: By this Rule the Opposite Party No. 1 was called upon to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and decree dated. 30.7.2002 passed by the learned Additional District fudge, 3rd Court, Comilla in Title Appeal No. 45 of 2002 dismissing the appeal and modifying the judgment and decree dated 26.1.2002 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Burichang, Comilla in Title Suit No. 75 of 1999 decreeing the suit in part should not be set aside and/ or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 5. The learned Assistant Judge upon consideration of the evidence On record decreed the suit in part directing the defendants to pay the salary of the plaintiff from March 1998 till institution Of the suit by the judgment and decree dated 26.1.2002. 

 6. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree the defendant No. I preferred Title Appeal No. 45 of 2002. That appeal was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla who by the impugned judgment and decree dated 30.7.2002 dismissed the appeal and modified the judgment and decree, of the trial Court and decreed the suit in full. By that decreed the learned Additional District Judge directed the defendants to pay the plaintiff's salary from March 1998 to up-to- date. 

 7. Being aggrieved by the impugned judgment and decree the defendants have obtained the instant Rule. 

 8. Mr. Md. Abdul Awal Mia on behalf of Mr. Mauzibur Rahman, the learned Advocate on appearing for the Petitioners submitted that the plaintiff although was show as a teacher of the school but she was not discharging her duties as a teacher. He submitted that the plaintiff claimed salary for the period of her studying in the H. S. C. class. He further submitted that the father of the plaintiff was the founder of the school and was a very influential person. Save and except this he could not point out any illegality or infirmity of the impugned judgment and decree. 

 12. In the result, The Rule is discharged' with a Costs of Tk.10,000.00. The impugned Judgment and decree dated 30.7.2002 passed by the  learned Additional District Judge, 3rd Court, Comilla in Title Appeal No. 45 of 2002 dismissing the appeal and modifying the judgment and decree dated 26.1.2002 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Burichang, Comilla in Title Suit No. 75 of 1999 are hereby affirmed. The Order of stay granted by this Court dated 23.11.2004 is hereby vacated.
